summary: Phase A+B Copilot Intelligence Layer end-to-end testing complete. Backend: 45/45 pytest cases PASS (23 contract + 22 live integration). Frontend: ChatView pickers, agent ribbon, all 3 slash widgets (/market, /sip, /fundcard) render correctly with the new envelope schema. /api/copilot/agents returns 7 specs; /api/copilot/models/picker returns 3 with gpt-4o is_default=true (legacy /api/copilot/models also present, no collision). Agent router correctly classifies all 6 canonical intents (tax/market/mf/portfolio/risk/report) via live HTTP. gpt-4o one-shot returns valid {text, agent_id, model_id}. market_brief returns kind=market_brief with agent.id=market_strategist + 1 live NIDP index (Bank Nifty) + FII/DII. sip_plan with monthly_budget=50000 risk=Moderate returns exactly 3 allocations totaling 50000. fund_card with query='Parag Parikh' correctly 404s when no MF master match (proper FastAPI detail contract). compare_funds with invalid scheme_codes returns 404 with detail. All endpoints are auth-gated (401 without session_token cookie). Frontend ChatView: agent-picker-toggle, model-picker-toggle, chat-input all present; agent picker shows 7 entries (agent-picker-{id}); model picker shows 3 entries with default button label = 'GPT-4o'. Slash commands route client-side and render proper widgets with FreshnessChip (LIVE/NIDP badge) and AgentRibbon. /fundcard 404 path shows a graceful chat-bubble error: "No mutual fund matched 'Parag Parikh'. Try a fuller scheme...".

integration_issues.issue: The 4 suggestion chips rendered under MarketBriefWidget ("Impact on my portfolio", "Which sectors should I trim?", "Set an alert on Nifty 50", "FII/DII trends over 5 days") are visible and clickable but do NOT carry a data-testid matching the spec pattern `suggestion-*`. Search for `[data-testid^="suggestion-"]` returned 0 matches. Add stable data-testids so automation can verify the suggestion-chip dispatcher.

Clicking the freshness chip ('LIVE · NIDP') did not surface a popover containing the words 'source' or 'updated/last updated' — only 'confidence' was detected in DOM text post-click. The popover may require hover instead of click, or it's not rendering source/lastUpdated metadata. Verify SourcePopover.jsx wiring: it should expose source array + lastUpdated timestamp + confidence on hover/click.

design_issues.screen: Copilot drawer (right side panel) hosting ChatView
issues: The drawer is narrow (~360px) which causes the FundCard/MarketBrief widget content to clip on the right (e.g., 'Compare these' button text gets truncated). Consider increasing default drawer width or making widget content horizontally scrollable.
Top header text 'AI Financial Advisor' gets truncated to 'AI Finan...' in narrow drawer — add title attribute or use ellipsis-with-tooltip pattern.

critical_code_review_comments: Auth-gating order: FastAPI Pydantic validation runs BEFORE the auth dependency on /api/copilot/widgets/fund_card (a body with too-short query returns 422 instead of 401 when unauthenticated). This is FastAPI's default behaviour and a known framework quirk — if strict 'auth-first' is required, move auth to a middleware or use Depends ordering tricks. Otherwise document the behaviour. Not a security issue (no data leaks) but worth noting for API contract clarity.

FreshnessChip popover: SourcePopover.jsx should expose all three fields (source[], lastUpdated, confidence) consistently — currently only confidence appears to render in the DOM post-click. Worth adding a data-testid='source-popover' wrapper and 'source-popover-{source,updated,confidence}' inner testids for stable verification.
